# apple_app_store_review_detail (Resource)

Sets the contact and sign-in information App Review uses for an App Store version. Changes need the version to be editable. App Store Connect has no way to delete review details, so destroying the resource leaves them. Import it by version ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_store_review_detail" "ios" {
  version_id            = apple_app_store_version.ios.id
  contact_first_name    = "Ann"
  contact_last_name     = "Example"
  contact_phone         = "+1 555 555 0100"
  contact_email         = "review@example.com"
  demo_account_required = true
  demo_account_name     = "reviewer@example.com"
  demo_account_password = var.review_password
  notes                 = "Sign in with the demo account to see the full app."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version, e.g. `apple_app_store_version.example.id`.

### Optional

- `contact_email` (String) Email address of App Review's contact.
- `contact_first_name` (String) First name of App Review's contact.
- `contact_last_name` (String) Last name of App Review's contact.
- `contact_phone` (String) Phone number of App Review's contact, with the country code, e.g. `+1 555 555 0100`.
- `demo_account_name` (String) User name of the demo account.
- `demo_account_password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the demo account.
- `demo_account_required` (Boolean) Whether App Review needs to sign in to review the app. Defaults to `false`.
- `notes` (String) Notes for App Review, up to 4,000 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the review details.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_store_review_detail.ios
  identity = {
    version_id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_store_review_detail.ios 1234567890
```
